::: {#exr-gpt3-energy}

#### Energy to train GPT-3

Training GPT-3 took $3.14 \times 10^{23}$ floating-point operations.
Its V100 GPUs each did $24.6 \times 10^{12}$ of them a second,
and each drew 330 watts,
counting its share of the memory, fans and host computer,
according to table 4 of @patterson2021carbon.
How much electrical energy did the GPUs use?

:::
